description: The rate limit of the diagnostics channel (REQ-DGN-003), a fixed window. State: the start of the window (-1 when there is none), the number allowed in it and the number suppressed since the last allowed one. For each call at now_ms: when there is no window or now_ms - window_start_ms >= window_ms, a new window starts at now_ms and its count is 0. Then, when the count is below limit the call is ALLOWED, the count grows by one, attach_suppressed is the number suppressed so far and that number goes back to 0; otherwise the call is suppressed (allow false, attach_suppressed 0) and the number suppressed grows by one. A clock that goes back stays in the window. The default of the library is 10 diagnostics per 1000 ms. expected is the answer of each call and expected_state the state at the end.

cases.name: first_call_is_allowed
cases.description: The first call opens a window and is allowed.

cases.name: limit_then_suppressed
cases.description: Three calls in one window are allowed; the fourth and fifth are suppressed.

cases.name: new_window_reports_the_suppressed
cases.description: The first diagnostic of the next window carries the number suppressed before it.

cases.name: window_edge_is_inclusive
cases.description: A call exactly window_ms after the start of the window opens a new window; one millisecond earlier does not.

cases.name: limit_of_one
cases.description: With a limit of one only the first call of each window is allowed.

cases.name: clock_goes_back_stays_in_the_window
cases.description: A clock that goes back is not a new window: the elapsed time is negative.

cases.name: long_silence
cases.description: After a long silence the window restarts at the call and nothing is suppressed.

cases.name: a_storm
cases.description: A thousand calls in 100 ms with a limit of 10 per 1000 ms allow ten and suppress 990.
